## Checklist for new or edited questions

- [ ] File is `questions/<kebab-case-id>.md`, copied from `questions/_template.md`
- [ ] `npm run check:questions` passes
- [ ] Statement describes the product and the task, not a solution
- [ ] Interviewer answers give concrete numbers (scale, latency, consistency) and what's out of scope
- [ ] At least 3 probes, written as short noun phrases
- [ ] I opened the question with `npm run dev` and it renders correctly
- [ ] The question is not confidential (no NDA-covered interview content copied verbatim)
